scope: Force-to-language labels for VLA training on phantom specimen A01; relative-magnitude labels only, no absolute newtons and no direction
quantity: r = F_tip / F_slip_ref, F_tip = hypot(bending_gripper_x, bending_gripper_y)
why_ratio: The decoupling matrix was fitted for a different load point, so every newton value carries one unknown multiplicative constant (phantom_force_A01/README.md limitation 1). A ratio to an in-dataset reference cancels it, exactly as the dataset own Phase 2 result does.

ratio_anchor.definition: median peak F_tip of the dry slip trials (protocol 4)
ratio_anchor.meaning: r = 1 is the tension at which the tissue escaped the jaws

event.traction_loss: r falls below 0.6 of the peak held over the preceding 1.6 s, from a peak in band 2 or above, and does not climb back to 0.85 of that peak within 0.5 s
event.why_not_called_slip: magnitude cannot tell an escaped grasp from a deliberate release. Trough persistence does not separate the stages: move_F troughs last longer (median 3.2 s) than slip_dry troughs (2.2 s). The event states what is measured -- the tension collapsed and stayed down.

subtype.from: handle gauge change across the drop, +-0.5 N nominal deadband
subtype.handle_held: handle force rose or held: the pattern of tissue escaping closed jaws
subtype.handle_opened: handle force fell: the pattern of a deliberate release
subtype.caveat: the handle gauge carries -1.07 to -1.20 N of bending contamination at 4.9 N and -1.57 N under 0.23 N.m of torsion (protocol 1), and bending is falling across the drop, so relief of that contamination pushes the reading up by a few tenths on its own. The separation above is larger than that, but the subtype is a cue, not a measurement.

stability.asymmetric: escalation immediate, de-escalation needs dwell + hysteresis
stability.why: at 100 Hz a raw threshold flickers across a boundary and the language label would change several times a second; the asymmetry keeps a rising force from being under-reported

noise_floor.note: no_load is kept strictly below anything the axis resolves

not_labelled: direction: theta clusters at 130-165 deg for all four move directions, so the bending_gripper_y calibration is stale (README limitation 2). move_L/R/F/B is carried as operator intent, never as a measured direction.
grasp force in newtons: the gripping gauge is on the handle lever, 0.5 N resolution with -1.57 N torsion contamination (protocol 1)
stiffness, displacement, axial thrust: no such channel exists
the 261021 surgilog session: no-load recording, refuse_unloaded_session() blocks it
remaining: Protocol appendix A-1 (push-type scale at the contact point) fixes the one constant that turns these ratios into absolute newtons; the band edges then stay as they are and only the anchor gains a unit.
One specimen and n=5 per stage, below the protocol n>=10; the anchor should be remeasured per specimen before the bands are quoted as phantom specifications.
A loaded session on the 261021 rig would give video + kinematics + force together; A01 has no MCU kinematics, so these labels carry no insertion depth or grip percentage.

refused_inputs.reason: no-load session. Live channels are bending_trocar_x/y at 1.4-2.2 mN against ~100 mN resolution (1/45), spectrally and statistically indistinguishable from the gauge-removed channels. Usable here only as the no_load class; force magnitude, trend and slip labels must not be derived from it (DATASET_MANUAL.md 6.1).
refused_inputs.may_still_contribute: the no_load class, and video + MCU kinematics, which are sound in that session
